reply:
TEXT and VARCHAR have identical read performance in Postgres. Both use varlena storage. The only difference is VARCHAR enforces a maximum length on write—there's no performance advantage to either for reads.

If you care only about read performance, choose based on whether you need the length constraint, not the type.
